text:
oliver: hitting a weird parity thing in the sampleapp rerank flow. Node SDK returns different shape for batched embeddings and our rerank blows up
oliver: node error: TypeError: candidate.embedding.map is not a function (at scoreCandidates)
priya: can you paste the raw payloads for a 2-item call from both SDKs?
oliver: python (fine):
```
[{
  "id": "doc1",
  "embedding": [0.001, -0.21, 0.003, ...],
  "model": "open-embed-1536"
}, {
  "id": "doc2",
  "embedding": [0.0009, 0.19, 0.002, ...],
  "model": "open-embed-1536"
}]
```
oliver: node (odd):
```
[{
  "id": "doc1",
  "vecs": "0.001,-0.21,0.003,...",
  "model": "open-embed-1536"
}, {
  "id": "doc2",
  "vecs": "0.0009,0.19,0.002,...",
  "model": "open-embed-1536"
}]
```
sam: interesting — node is emitting `vecs` as CSV strings for batched responses. single-item node calls still return `embedding: number[]`, right?
oliver: yep single-input is fine. only when input is an array (>1) we get `vecs` csvs
lee: that sounds like the batching helper is doing compact serialization on the wire and the deserializer isn't converting back. any chance the auth/retry middleware is joining chunk buffers and stripping brackets? we had a bug like that with streaming last sprint
sam: plausible. if retry stitching uses Buffer.concat then toString without checking JSON boundaries could yield a blob like "0.001,-0.21,..." instead of [0.001,-0.21,...]
priya: repro steps for node:
```js
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1536', input: ['a','b'] })
console.log(res)
```
// observed: res[0].vecs -> "0.001,-0.21,0.003,..."
sam: short-term workaround for onboarding/sampleapp: normalize after SDK call: detect `vecs` or string `embedding` and coerce: `const ensure = v => typeof v === 'string' ? v.split(',').map(Number) : v` then map to `embedding` before rerank
oliver: that fixed my local smoke tests. i'll add the snippet to sampleapp quickstart and open a PR
ci-bot: CI: embed-shape-check failed on node-samples (expected embedding:number[] but got vecs:string)
lee: i'll add a regression test in the node SDK and schedule a patch. sam, can you triage whether batching helper or retry stitch is responsible? prioritize parity with python for the onboarding flow
sam: will investigate both. if it's the batching helper we can revert the compact serialization change; if it's the retry path we need a safe stitch that preserves JSON structure. also adding an e2e test that compares node vs python response shapes on CI to catch regressions
priya: thanks all 64f i'll update the onboarding troubleshooting doc with the workaround and link the sampleapp PR once ready
oliver: PR opened: redwood/devex#1977 with the fix and test. tagging @sam for follow-up on the SDK patch
priya: nice work. :thumbsup:
